title: Critical Tribes Probability Excess
statement: For each block width $w$, let $N_w$ be the dimension of the critical tribes function and let $d_w$ be its probability deficit from $1/2$. Then the excess $(1/2+d_w)-1/2$ is $O\!\left(\log(N_w)/N_w\right)$ as $w\to\infty$.
